title: Lumbar Spine MRI - Medicare Advantage Plus

1.title: Scope and applicability
statements: 1.1 This policy applies to MRI of the lumbar spine (CPT 72148, 72149, 72158) for adult members.
1.3 Governing date. The policy version in effect on the date the authorization request is received governs the review, regardless of the scheduled service date.
1.4 Precedence. This plan-specific policy takes precedence over the general lumbar spine MRI policy for Medicare Advantage Plus members.

2.title: Medical necessity criteria
2.note: All of the following must be met unless the red flag pathway (Section 3) or an exception (Section 5) applies.

criteria.text: Low back pain has persisted for at least 4 weeks (28 days), with the onset date documented.
At least 4 weeks of conservative therapy (physical therapy, home exercise program, and/or NSAIDs or analgesics).
A clinical examination (musculoskeletal and neurological) by the treating clinician is documented within 30 days before the request date.
No lumbar spine MRI or CT was performed in the prior 12 months, unless a new or progressive neurological deficit has been documented since that imaging.

3.title: Red flag pathway
statements: 3.1 RF-01. Any of: new or progressive motor deficit, suspected cauda equina syndrome, suspected spinal infection, or suspected malignancy. When RF-01 is documented, C-01 and C-02 are waived. C-03 still applies.

4.title: Exclusions
statements: 4.1 EX-01. Routine imaging for non-specific low back pain without red flags before the minimum symptom and treatment durations are met.
4.2 EX-02. Imaging requested solely at patient request without clinical indication.

5.title: Exceptions
statements: 5.1 No exceptions are defined in this version.

6.title: Rationale
statements: 6.1 MRI is indicated when persistent low back pain has not responded to conservative treatment, or when red flags are present.
